cards.anchor: P1 supplies the five-place rack for ordered P2 inspection; the existing trolley routine fits nine source carriers and two charged trips.
cards.burden: Transfer clerk occupies seven minutes; inspection clerk occupies thirteen, including B9 correction. Both trolley allowances are consumed. The rival occupies nine transfer minutes.
cards.construction: Start trolley B4-B7 at 0, unloading at 3; trolley B8-B11 at 3, unloading at 6; hand carry B12 at 6, unloading at 7. Inspect continuously: B1-B8 finish at 1-8, B9 runs 8-10 with the spare bracket, and B10-B12 finish at 11-13. Seal only after correct counting.
cards.defeat: Reject the proposed benefit if the legal candidate trace requires unloading waits or an inspection gap, fails any correct release by 13, or occupies at least nine transfer minutes. Apply the transfer preference only after complete success.
cards.mutation: Consolidate the ordinary full-load routine into two four-carrier trolley trips followed immediately by one permitted hand trip.
cards.prediction_candidate: Finite-model calculation predicts nine source unloads, twelve correct releases and 120 released brackets by 13, zero unloading waits, seven transfer minutes and thirteen inspection minutes; maximum rack occupancy is five. Execution is unobserved.
cards.prediction_rival: Consecutive hand trips predict the same nine unloads, twelve releases and 120 brackets by 13, with nine transfer minutes and thirteen inspection minutes. The competing blocking account instead predicts a trolley wait or inspection gap and deadline failure.
cards.probe: Compare legal boundary-by-boundary event traces of both schedules using carrier identities, counts at completed releases, clerk occupied intervals, rack occupancy, waiting loads and charge use. Independently check P1 unloads and P2 releases; packing marks alone do not count.
cards.rival: Hand carry B4-B12 consecutively from 0 to 9 while inspection follows arrival order and corrects B9.
unknowns: Later request-frequency adaptation is unobserved and does not change this window.
No empirical trial, performance distribution or global optimality proof is supplied.
